Dribble 2026 privacy policy

Last updated September 6, 2026.

Dribble 2026 is a single-player college basketball dynasty game. Dynasty files, tutorial flags, and settings stay on this device (local storage). We do not create an account for you, we do not sell data, and we do not run ads or trackers in the app.

Schools, leagues, and boards in the game are original facsimile names. They are not affiliated with any university, conference, or media company.

If you contact support, we only see what you send. Delete the app to wipe local saves.
